title: The Psychology of Social Media: Why You Can't Stop Scrolling (Long Listen)
desc: Why is it so hard to put the phone down? A calm, sourced long listen about what feeds really do to attention, mood, sleep, memory and friendship: variable rewards and the pull to refresh, what a like does in the brain, social comparison, passive versus active use, the big debate about wellbeing and what the largest studies found, quitting and limiting experiments, the cost of interruption, how true and false stories spread, mood contagion, echo chambers, photos and memory, sleep and the fear of missing out, the performed self, loneliness and friendship, and what actually helps. It ends with a gentle wind-down for sleep. Every claim comes from named studies, and the doubts are left in.
